import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class MazeFlow {
    static char[][] mazeX, mazeY;
    static int sizeN, maxT;
    static boolean[][][][][] visitedStates;
    static boolean[][][][] reachability;
    static int[][] timeGrid;
    static final int MAX_T = 70;
    static final int MAX_N = 12;

    static void exploreDP(int step, int x, int y, int xRef, int yRef) {
        if (maxT >= MAX_T || x < 0 || x >= sizeN || y < 0 || y >= sizeN)
            return;
        if (mazeX[x][y] < '0' || mazeX[x][y] > '9')
            return;
        if (step > maxT + 1)
            return;
        if (visitedStates[step][x][y][xRef][yRef])
            return;
        if (timeGrid[x][y] != 0 && step > timeGrid[x][y])
            return;
        if (timeGrid[x][y] == step && (mazeY[x][y] > '9' || mazeY[x][y] <= '0'))
            return;
        visitedStates[step][x][y][xRef][yRef] = true;

        if (step < timeGrid[x][y]) {
            exploreDP(step + 1, x, y, xRef, yRef);
            exploreDP(step + 1, x + 1, y, xRef, yRef);
            exploreDP(step + 1, x - 1, y, xRef, yRef);
            exploreDP(step + 1, x, y + 1, xRef, yRef);
            exploreDP(step + 1, x, y - 1, xRef, yRef);
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int t = sc.nextInt();
        sizeN = n;
        maxT = t;

        mazeX = new char[n][n];
        mazeY = new char[n][n];

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            mazeX[i] = sc.next().toCharArray();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            mazeY[i] = sc.next().toCharArray();

        List<List<Integer>> graph = new ArrayList<>();
        int[] E = new int[210];
        int[] H = new int[210];
        int[][] C = new int[210][210];
        int[][] pN = new int[11][11];

        for (int[] row : C)
            Arrays.fill(row, 0);
        for (int[] row : pN)
            Arrays.fill(row, 0);

        boolean[][][][][] visitedStates = new boolean[MAX_T + 2][n][n][n][n];
        boolean[][][][] reachability = new boolean[n][n][n][n];
        int[][] timeGrid = new int[n][n];

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            Arrays.fill(timeGrid[i], -1);

        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++)
                if (mazeX[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    timeGrid[i][j] = 0;
                    q.offer(new int[]{i, j});
                }

        int[] di = {-1, 0, 1, 0};
        int[] dj = {0, -1, 0, 1};

        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] p = q.poll();
            int pi = p[0], pj = p[1];
            if (timeGrid[pi][pj] >= t) continue;
            for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                int ni = pi + di[d], nj = pj + dj[d];
                if (ni >= 0 && ni < n && nj >= 0 && nj < n && mazeX[ni][nj] >= '0' && mazeX[ni][nj] <= '9' && timeGrid[ni][nj] == -1) {
                    timeGrid[ni][nj] = timeGrid[pi][pj] + 1;
                    q.offer(new int[]{ni, nj});
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++)
                if (timeGrid[i][j] == -1)
                    timeGrid[i][j] = t;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++)
                if (mazeX[i][j] >= '0' && mazeX[i][j] <= '9') {
                    exploreDP(0, i, j, i, j);
                }

        List<Integer> startNodes = new ArrayList<>();
        graph.add(startNodes);

        for (int i1 = 0; i1 < n; i1++)
            for (int j1 = 0; j1 < n; j1++)
                for (int i2 = 0; i2 < n; i2++)
                    for (int j2 = 0; j2 < n; j2++)
                        for (int nt = 0; nt <= t; nt++)
                            reachability[i1][j1][i2][j2] |= visitedStates[nt][i1][j1][i2][j2];

        for (int i1 = 0; i1 < n; i1++)
            for (int j1 = 0; j1 < n; j1++)
                if (mazeX[i1][j1] > '0' && mazeX[i1][j1] <= '9') {
                    int k = graph.size();
                    List<Integer> g = new ArrayList<>();
                    graph.add(g);
                    E[k] = mazeX[i1][j1] - '0';

                    for (int i2 = 0; i2 < n; i2++)
                        for (int j2 = 0; j2 < n; j2++)
                            if (mazeY[i2][j2] > '0' && mazeY[i2][j2] <= '9')
                                if (reachability[i2][j2][i1][j1]) {
                                    int _k;
                                    if (pN[i2][j2] == 0) {
                                        List<Integer> _g = new ArrayList<>();
                                        _k = graph.size();
                                        graph.add(_g);
                                        pN[i2][j2] = _k;
                                    } else {
                                        _k = pN[i2][j2];
                                    }
                                    graph.get(k).add(_k);
                                    graph.get(_k).add(k);
                                    C[k][_k] = 10000;
                                    C[_k][k] = 0;
                                }
                }

        for (int i2 = 0; i2 < n; i2++)
            for (int j2 = 0; j2 < n; j2++)
                if (mazeY[i2][j2] > '0' && mazeY[i2][j2] <= '9' && pN[i2][j2] > 0) {
                    int _k = pN[i2][j2];
                    graph.get(_k).add(0);
                    C[_k][0] = mazeY[i2][j2] - '0';
                    C[0][_k] = 0;
                }

        // Implementing max flow (Dinic's algorithm)
        int source = 0;
        int sink = 0; // sink is node 0
        int size = graph.size();

        int[] E_flow = new int[size];
        int[] Hh = new int[size];
        int[][] capacity = C;

        // Initialize E_flow
        for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
            E_flow[i] = 0;
        }

        // Initialize H
        Arrays.fill(Hh, 0);

        // Initialize E for nodes
        for (int i = 1; i < size; i++) {
            E_flow[i] = E[i];
        }

        boolean doneFlag;
        do {
            doneFlag = true;
            for (int i = 1; i < size; i++) {
                while (E_flow[i] > 0) {
                    boolean moved = false;
                    int minH = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
                    for (int neighbor : graph.get(i)) {
                        if (capacity[i][neighbor] - E_flow[neighbor] > 0 && Hh[i] == Hh[neighbor] + 1) {
                            int flow = Math.min(capacity[i][neighbor] - E_flow[neighbor], E_flow[i]);
                            E_flow[i] -= flow;
                            E_flow[neighbor] += flow;
                            moved = true;
                            doneFlag = false;
                            if (E_flow[i] == 0) break;
                        }
                        minH = Math.min(minH, Hh[neighbor]);
                    }
                    if (Hh[i] != minH + 1 && minH != Integer.MAX_VALUE)
                        Hh[i] = minH + 1;
                    if (moved) break;
                }
            }
        } while (!doneFlag);

        System.out.println(E_flow[source]);
        sc.close();
    }
}
